body.message:
Here is the rate breakdown for the 3-month booking:

November: AED 20,400 for 30 nights
December: AED 44,000 for 30 nights
January: AED 33,000 for 30 nights

Please note that each month is calculated based on 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the 3-month booking, as the stay covers the New Year period, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent need to be paid in advance.

Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you for your understanding.
